1879060752.name: Lightning-charged Staff Strike
1879060752.desc: Strike hard with your staff, summoning a lightning strike.\n\n<rgb=#ff0091>With Improved Ignition, this skill can cash-out Burning Embers for bonus damage.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: Lightning Skills gain the ability to consume Burning Embers for bonus damage\n\nWhen consuming higher tiers of Burning Embers, this damage is greatly increased.

1879064080.name: Stallion's Spirit
1879064080.desc: This fellowship skill replenishes your power and can contribute to fellowship manoeuvres.

1879064208.name: Still As Death
1879064208.desc: You are talented at feigning death, causing enemies to ignore you completely.

1879064336.name: Mischievous Glee
1879064336.desc: Your mischief never ceases to delight and amuse you.

1879072528.name: Disarm
1879072528.desc: With a flash of steel you render your target unable to use their weapons for a short while. This skill can only be used against players.

1879091728.name: Withdraw
1879091728.desc: Breaks the effects of Dazes, Stuns and Knockdowns.

1879115152.name: 1H Weapon Attack
1879115152.desc: Auto-attack when wielding only a single one-handed weapon.

1879117456.name: Power Attack
1879117456.desc: A powerful weapon blow which deals damage over time.

1879153296.name: Hampering Javelin of Fire
1879153296.desc: Javelins can pierce body parts or equipment and slow the target until the javelin can be removed.

1879162768.name: Return to Bree
1879162768.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Men of Bree, you're able to quickly return to Bree. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879188496.name: Fly True
1879188496.desc: This shot can only be used against those that bear the Dúnedain Mark, but once marked, the enemy takes devastating damage.  This skill can only be used from stealth.  It will never miss against on-level creatures.  On a critical the target will take power damage as well.

1879198352.name: Friend of Large Hunters (Striped Sabre-cat)
1879198352.desc: Summons a sabre-tooth cat companion.\n\nThe sabre-tooth cat hails from the north and can wield the cold of its home.

1879208720.name: Saffron's Lipstick
1879208720.desc: Warning: Kissing someone with this lipstick will leave him feeling groggy.\n\nA very special kiss...

1879213328.name: Improved Guardian's Defence
1879213328.desc: This stance focuses your defences on blocking attacks.  Causes enemies that attack you to continue to attack you or they will be snared.

1879231376.name: Ranged Wall of Steel
1879231376.desc: A weaving throw, dealing strong direct damage.

The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks up to 2 times.
The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks up to 3 times.

1879242000.name: Rohan's Edge
1879242000.desc: A powerful attack, further enhanced when landing a critical strike that will cause your next attack to inspire you and your nearby fellowship members.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>After scoring a critical with Rohan's Edge, your next skill-based attack will instantly restore a small amount of morale to you, your fellowship members and war-steeds within 40 metres.</rgb>

Up to once per second, when you Block or Partially Block:

1879243920.name: Improved Hampering Javelin of Fire
1879243920.desc: A precise throw can pin a target to the ground and hinder its movement for a short while thereafter.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Root replaced with a mount acceleration debuff</rgb>

1879270544.name: Barrage of Fire 3
1879270544.desc: A quick attack that deals more damage each time it is used.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.

1879277200.name: Spooky Pony of the Bat
1879277200.desc: A pony from the Fall Festival.

1879291408.name: Pleasant Breeze
1879291408.desc: Direct a pleasant breeze towards your allies to re-invigourate them.

1879311248.name: Biting Edge
1879311248.desc: Two quick and vicious strikes across an enemy.

Vexation: \n Upon taking damage in Man form (20% chance in bear form):
Evading an attack applies an Incoming Healing bonus to you. This can only trigger once every 12 seconds.
DNT - parrying an Attack builds threat.  Evading an Attack builds Wrath.

1879389712.name: Black Pig
1879389712.desc: Brings out a black pig to keep you company.

1879391248.name: Stout-shield
1879391248.desc: After years of toil in Mordor, your skin has hardened to stone. Through great concentration you have learned to more effectively block attacks - even without the use of a shield.

1879408144.name: Green Firefly
1879408144.desc: Summons a green firefly to keep you company.

1879411088.name: Coffee Goat
1879411088.desc: A little goat who would like to see the world with you.

1879414544.name: Yule Tree Huorn
1879414544.desc: Summons a huorn who dressed for Yule.

1879416080.name: Muster in Trestlebridge
1879416080.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Trestlebridge

1879416848.name: Wild Trestlebridge Steed
1879416848.desc: A wild steed of the Wildwood.

1879417104.name: Wild Young Moose
1879417104.desc: This young moose enjoys hikes in the woods.

1879419536.name: Return to Akrâz-zahar
1879419536.desc: You're able to quickly return to Akrâz-zahar. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879447696.name: Share Innate Strength: Balance
1879447696.desc:
Bolster your fellowship and raid members with a portion of your Innate Strength: Balance.
<rgb=#FF0000>Requires a Tier 4 Innate Strength: Balance buff to be present on the Brawler.</rgb>

<rgb=#00FF00>If Specialized as The Fulcrum, all Fellowship and Raid Members within 15m gain: 
Increased Parry Chance

If specialized as The Maelstrom, all Fellowship and Raid Members within 15m gain:
Increased Finesse</rgb>

1879457552.name: Shield Up
1879457552.desc: Briefly raise your shield to increase your defences.

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879466128.name: Protection by the Shield
1879466128.desc: Fellowship and Raid members near you receive less damage.

1879466256.name: Sea Legs
1879466256.desc: Regain some balance and free yourself from negative combat states.

1879473808.name: Parrot
1879473808.desc: Summons a colourful parrot to accompany you on your journeys.

1879475984.name: Muster at Halrax
1879475984.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Halrax in the Shield Isles.

1879483280.name: Reckless Slam (Dual)

1879491216.desc:
Rapidly falling pressure around your foe creates a crushing sensation.
This skill has extra Critical Chance and Critical Magnitude.

If this skill is used whilst your companion flanks the enemy, your Morale will be healed.

1879501840.name: Shield of Blood
1879501840.desc: Steal Kormoltur's power and shield your allies from his whisper of blood.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>The mushroom will explode when dropped.</rgb>

1879506576.name: Engulf
1879506576.desc: Shadows briefly swallow your target, crushing their will to fight.

1879506832.name: Sinister Plan
1879506832.desc: Beguile and slash many targets, leaving them bleeding while also restoring Power.

1879508752.name: Return to Ahâba
1879508752.desc: You're able to quickly return to Ahâba in Idagâl in Mûr Ghala. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879517200.name: Fall Hobby-broom
1879517200.desc: A creative Harvestmath toy.\n\nYou may ride it in most towns and cities.
